description: A warm, friendly woman in her thirties or forties with a clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, a native Italian speaker with a standard Italian accent. She says a short prayer aloud the way people say it together in church every day: fluent and flowing, at a normal conversational speed, warm and sincere, without dragging and without dramatic pauses.
ref_text: Gloria al Padre e al Figlio e allo Spirito Santo. Come era nel principio, e ora e sempre, nei secoli dei secoli. Amen.
